extraction.text:
Pratima Thakur

📞 +91-7391069962 | ✉️ thakurpratima1592@gmail.com | Pune, India

Senior Java Architect | Engineering Leader | Microservices Expert

Professional Summary

Accomplished Senior Java Professional with 12+ years of progressive experience in designing, developing, and delivering scalable enterprise applications using Java 8+, Spring Boot, and Microservices architecture. Proven expertise in leading teams, delivering full SDLC projects across Banking, Finance, Telecom, and Transportation domains.

Known for strong technical leadership, hands-on problem-solving, and aligning engineering goals with business outcomes. Adept in Agile delivery, performance optimization, DevOps practices, and cloud-native microservices.

Key Competencies

Technical Skill Set

Technical Expertise: Java 8+, Java 17, Spring MVC, Spring Boot, Microservices, RESTful APIs, Hibernate, JUnit (Mockito framework), Struts 1.x+, Apache Camel, Maven, Docker, Kubernetes.

Databases: PostgreSQL, Oracle, MySQL, Elasticsearch, MongoDB.

DevOps & Tools: Git, Jenkins, SonarQube, JIRA, Swagger, Eclipse, IntelliJ, Cucumber, Ansible, Nexus, Jasper Tool, GraphQL.

Architecture & Practices: Microservices, CI/CD, Design Patterns, Agile (Scrum), BDD.

Domain Expertise: Banking & Finance (Clearing & Settlement, GDPR, Tri-party REPO), Telecom, Cybersecurity.

Servers: JBoss, Tomcat, WebLogic.

Cloud Platforms: AWS, Google Cloud Platform (GCP), Microsoft Azure, AWS Lambda (serverless computing).

Operating Systems: Linux, Windows, Unix.

Queue: Rabbit MQ, JMS, Kafka

Spring cloud integration: API Gateway, Spring security.

Professional Experience

Synechron Technologies Pvt. Ltd. – Pune

Team Lead / Senior Java Developer
Dec 2019 – Present

Led microservices-based transformation projects for HSBC and TransAmerica (Paris3, DDOL), migrating legacy Struts to modern Spring Boot architectures.
- Delivered ORC (Omnia Return Calculator) – a high-performance calculator using Spring Boot with Agile practices.
- Architected secure, scalable systems ensuring high availability and integration with REST APIs.

Vodafone Shared Services – Pune

Deputy Manager – Java Development
Sep 2017 – Dec 2019

Delivered GDPR-compliant systems ensuring data privacy and transparency.
- Built “Event Collector” – a high-performance RESTful component using Jersey, Log4J, and Tomcat.
- Delivered code with >90% unit test coverage and enforced coding standards using Sonar & PMD.

Benison Technologies – Pune

Senior Software Engineer
Mar 2017 – Jun 2017

Contributed to the RedSeal Network Security product, integrating configuration management and vulnerability assessments.
- Worked across the product lifecycle including bug identification, feature development, and deployment.

Fujitsu Consulting India – Pune

Senior Application Developer
Dec 2015 – Jan 2017

Developed ACT Smartcard SaaS platform using microservices and REST APIs.
- Automated deployments via Jenkins and maintained integration documentation via Confluence.

Tata Consultancy Services (TCS) – Pune

Associate Software Engineer
Dec 2012 – Dec 2015

Played a key role in the Neuro Trading Platform (Deutsche Bank) and Data Migration Projects.
- Developed and supported batch processing systems with XML/CSV parsing, error handling, and auditing.
- Delivered production-ready Java applications with strong focus on quality, scalability, and compliance.

Certifications & Additional Highlights

Hands-on expertise with Docker, Kubernetes, Cucumber BDD, and CI/CD pipelines
- Experienced in client interaction, requirement analysis, onshore-offshore coordination
- Delivered critical BFSI solutions with tight regulatory compliance and agile governance

Education

Qualification Year Percentage 10th 2004 80% 12th 2006 78% B.Sc – D.A.V.V. University 2009 80% MCA – R.G.P.V. University 2012 80.10%
